einzeiler: A dentist plotted to murder his wife with poisons while hiding affairs and debt.
kurzfassung: Angela Craig fell severely ill over several days and eventually died after her husband, Jim Craig, secretly ordered multiple lethal poisons online. Investigators discovered a trail of digital evidence, web searches for poisons, and hidden affairs that pointed directly to Jim. Despite his attempts to frame the death as suicide and fabricate false evidence from jail, a jury convicted him of first-degree murder.
stichpunkte: Angela Craig suffered a mysterious, rapid decline over nine days before being declared brain dead in March 2023.
Investigators discovered Jim Craig had ordered potassium cyanide, pure arsenic, and oleander online.
Digital evidence revealed Jim purchased numerous bottles of Visine, whose active ingredient is toxic when ingested.
Jim maintained secret affairs, financial struggles, and a double life while projecting a happy marriage.
Following his arrest, Jim attempted to solicit a fellow inmate to tamper with evidence and fabricate a deepfake video.
The defense argued that Angela committed suicide due to emotional distress, but the jury rejected the claim.
Jim Craig was found guilty on all charges and sentenced to life in prison without the possibility of parole.

clips.hook: Arrested in the parking lot under false pretenses
clips.text: Jim thought he was simply picking up his seized phone from the police station, but officers met him in the parking lot to take him into custody for murder.

clips.hook: The sudden onset of a mysterious illness
clips.text: After riding her bike and drinking a protein shake prepared by her husband, Angela rapidly transitioned from feeling completely fine to experiencing severe neurological symptoms.

clips.hook: Bulk purchases of common eye drops used as poison
clips.text: Digital records showed the suspect bought 19 bottles of Visine over a two-day period, utilizing its toxic active ingredient as part of the poisoning scheme.

beschreibung:
Angela Craig falls seriously ill without warning, leaving doctors puzzled. Soon, investigators start to find troubling evidence connected to her husband, Jim Craig. Their discoveries make friends and family rethink what they believed about the couple. As the investigation continues, the case only gets more unusual.
